boardManifestNote: 2026-09-24: each migrated source now embeds its board.json (minus id) as the document-level HangTenBoardManifest property; only Document.xml changed in each FCStd. board.json is regenerated from it in canonical layout (token-identical to the hand-authored file: same values, key order, and number spellings; only whitespace and string escaping changed, for captain-fingerfood-pocket and both lattice-mxedge-lift packages). lattice-mxedge-lift-small's previous sourceSHA256 (df02a018...) was already stale against the committed source before this change.
buildTimeBoardJSONNote: 2026-09-24: CAD-backed board.json is no longer committed; it is generated from the locked FCStd at build time (package validation, iOS and Android staging). sha256Manifest now covers descriptor + FCStd for the five source-backed packages instead of descriptor + board.json + FCStd; the previous manifest 4af6ea74... moved to supersededSha256Manifest (which previously held abfe9228...). The generated board.json bytes are identical to the last committed ones.
inventoryNote: main's lock listed 40 model-media packages while the merged tree contains 46, because PR #452 migrated six further boards without refreshing it. The lock now covers all 46.
